We need to determine SMILES of unknown organic compound given no data yet. We have to possibly use measurement tools to get spectra. But we want to minimize cost. However we have no initial info. Perhaps the sample is unknown; we need to deduce from spectra. We need to decide which measurement to run first. Typically mass spectrometry is cheap? Not sure. But we have to get enough info to propose SMILES.

We could start with mass spectrometry to get molecular weight and formula. Then maybe carbon NMR, proton NMR. But we want minimal steps. Could we use search_by_smiles? No we need SMILES.

We have no hints. Perhaps the sample is simple known compound? Could be something like ethanol? But we can't guess.

We need to run mass spectrometry first. Use tool mass_spectrometry_spectra().
